build_identity: Hollow Form → Whirling Assault = main boss DPS
Shattering Palm = clear / Cold / Chill / Freeze / overkill
Lightning / Shock / Charged Staff = secondary damage + control
locked_mechanical_rules: Do not reintroduce Hollow Palm despite legacy filenames/descriptions.
Fists of Stone via Way of the Stonefist is mechanically mandatory.
For passive-tree visuals, use the union of 120 main passives + 8 spent Martial Artist passives; do not display or discuss Weapon Sets.
Do not use generative image tools to reconstruct passive-tree topology.

serialized_scope_counts.note: These tags are preserved only as source metadata. The final passive-tree visual intentionally hides Weapon Sets.

baseline_common_plus_ascendancy.spectral_ward: Maximum ES gains +1 per 12 Item Evasion on equipped Body Armour.

important_conditional_damage_lines: Crashing Wave: 25% increased Damage after a Critical Hit in the past 8 seconds.
Killer Instinct: 40% increased Attack Damage on Full Life / 60% increased Attack Damage on Low Life.
Electrifying Daze: gain 12% of Physical Damage as Extra Lightning against Dazed enemies.
Shattering Daze: gain 12% of Physical Damage as Extra Cold against Dazed enemies.
Chakra of Impact: 8% increased Damage per Combo consumed, up to 40%.
Material Solidification: gain 8% of Damage as Extra Physical Damage.
derived_mechanical_index.interpretation_warning: Totals above are arithmetic summaries of explicit selected-node modifiers from data.json and serialized allocation tags. They are not a full PoE damage calculation and do not resolve in-game interaction order, gear, skill-local modifiers or unverified Weapon Set behavior.

reasoning_policy: Distinguish locked facts, current working choices, and unresolved items.
Never treat a poster's text as stronger evidence than Master Context or data.json.
When calculating tree bonuses, use node stats from data.json and preserve conditions instead of flattening conditional modifiers.
When a question depends on Weapon Sets, revisit serialized weapon_set tags explicitly; do not infer from the 120-node union visual.
When a question depends on gear affixes, do not use the concept ring affixes as real 0.5.2 availability without a fresh audit.
